name: lab4
description: 1. create project folder 2. right click on project folder and select open integrated terminal ![alt text](./images.png) 3. type in terminal `npm init -y` press enter 4. open package.json file from project folder 5. update type as `type:module` in package.json ![alt text](./imaegs-1.png) 6. type in terminal `npm i nodemon -D` to install nodemon, which restarts server while file changes. -D flag indicate install in dev dependency 7. it creates node_modules and package.json
